name: Indexes
summary: Multi-page indexes for long decks: slide-by-slide indexes (dense lists, typed tables and thumbnails), section maps, an A to Z topic index, an exhibit list and an appendix index, for the sample Northfield Health System proposal.

templates.name: Slide index · two columns, first page
templates.purpose: First page of a multi-page slide index for a long deck: about 24 slides in two columns, grouped by section with a numbered section header and page range, each slide with its title and page.

slots.note: number, name and page range; repeated with 'continued' where a section crosses a page

slide.title: Every slide in the proposal, by section and page

items.text: What we heard from your leaders
How we work with your team

templates.name: Slide index · continued page
templates.purpose: Continuation page of the slide index: same two-column grid, section headers marked 'continued' where a section carries over from the previous page, and 'Index 2 of 3' in the stamp.

slots.note: number, name and page range; repeated with 'continued' where a section crosses a page

slide.title: Every slide in the proposal, by section and page

templates.name: Slide index · last page
templates.purpose: Final page of the slide index: the last sections including the appendix, with 'Index 3 of 3' in the stamp.

slots.note: number, name and page range; repeated with 'continued' where a section crosses a page

slide.title: Every slide in the proposal, by section and page

templates.name: Slide index · table with type
templates.purpose: Slide index as a table: slide reference, title, a short type tag and page, grouped by section with vertical row-group cells; first of a multi-page set.

slots.note: slide ref, title (maxChars 34), type tag (one word), page

slide.title: Every slide with its type and page

rows.t: What we heard from your leaders

templates.name: Slide index · table with type, continued
templates.purpose: Continuation page of the typed slide index: the section group carries over from the previous page and the stamp shows the page of pages.

slots.note: slide ref, title (maxChars 34), type tag (one word), page

slide.title: Every slide with its type and page

rows.t: How we work with your team

templates.name: Slide index · thumbnails
templates.purpose: Visual slide index: twelve small slide thumbnails per page in two section bands of six, each captioned with its number and title.

slots.note: kind (text, table, chart, diagram); caption: number and title (maxChars 26)

slide.title: Team and commercials at a glance

templates.name: Section map · pages, slides and share
templates.purpose: One-page map of a long deck: each section with its numbered badge, what it covers, page range, slide count and share of the deck.

slide.title: Seven sections, 76 pages: where each part sits

rows.cov: Title page and the three-page slide index
Your goals, the close today and what success looks like
Three waves, timeline, governance and risks
Operating model, systems, controls and cutover
Leadership, delivery team and your team's role
Fees, assumptions, business case and next steps
Healthcare finance experience, results and references
Twelve supporting exhibits, A1 to A12

body.text: 76 pages in all. Solution is the largest section at 18 slides; the appendix holds the supporting detail.

templates.name: Section index · nav rail
templates.purpose: Index of one section on the nav rail: the rail shows which section, and the section's slides are listed in three grouped columns with page numbers and neighbouring sections below.

slide.title: Solution: eighteen slides in three parts

templates.name: Topic index · A to Z, three columns
templates.purpose: Back-of-book topic index: forty-five terms in three alphabetical columns with a blue letter at each new initial, a dotted leader and the pages where the term appears.

slots.note: term (maxChars 20), page references such as '9, 32, 66' or '42–43'

slide.title: Find any topic, A to Z, by page

templates.name: Exhibit index · figures and tables
templates.purpose: List of exhibits, figures and tables for a long deck: twenty numbered exhibits in two columns, each with its title and page.

slide.title: Twenty exhibits, figures and tables, by page

items.text: Where the days go in a close

templates.name: Appendix index · A1 to A12
templates.purpose: Appendix index on one page: twelve numbered appendix items with a short description of what each contains and its page.

slide.title: Twelve appendix items, A1 to A12

rows.d: Who we spoke with and the themes that emerged
Task-level calendar for each entity, day 1 to day 12
Findings and baselines for each of the eight entities
All balance-sheet reconciliations with owners and frequency
Current-state and future-state maps for the close
Applications, interfaces and data owners in scope
Key controls mapped to risks and audit assertions
Activities, durations and dependencies by wave
How the phase fees are built from team and effort
Roles, allocation and timing across the three waves
A comparable health system close transformation

body.text: Pages 63 and 64 hold the appendix divider and this index.
